#Fig 1
# merge age - species level
```{r}
# add group info
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(age_group = ifelse(age_MBC_dx < 50, "<50", "≥50"))

sample_data(physeq) <- meta
physeq_other_Species <- physeq %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Species") %>%
  psmelt() %>% 
  mutate(
    Species = as.character(Species),
    Taxa_Order = Species
  )
# merge age- species level
df_species_mean_age <- physeq_other_Species %>%
  group_by(age_group, Species) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Taxa_Order = Species)

# top20 species by global mean
top20_species <- df_species_mean_age %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(global_mean = mean(mean_abund)) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_mean)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(Species)

# Others
df_species_mean_age <- df_species_mean_age %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% top20_species, Species, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(age_group, Species) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = sum(mean_abund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c(top20_species, "Others")))


unique(df_species_mean_age$Species)

cols_species <- c(
  "Hydrocarboniphaga_effusa"      = "#8DD3C7",
  "Rothia_sp002492045"            = "#FFFFB3",
  "Bacillus_A_bombysepticus"      = "#BEBADA",
  "Chlamydophila_abortus"         = "#FB8072",
  "Stenotrophomonas_pavanii"      = "#80B1D3",
  "Bacillus_A_cereus"             = "#FDB462",
  "Acinetobacter_soli"            = "#B3DE69",
  "Klebsiella_pneumoniae"         = "#FCCDE5",
  "Cutibacterium_acnes"           = "#A6CEE3",
  "QFNR01_sp003248485"            = "#BC80BD",
  "Acinetobacter_johnsonii"       = "#CCEBC5",
  "Campylobacter_testudinum"      = "#FFED6F",
  "Clostridioides_difficile"      = "#1B9E77",
  "Bacillus_A_thuringiensis_S"    = "#D95F02",
  "Moraxella_A_cinereus"          = "#7570B3",
  "Staphylococcus_aureus"         = "#E7298A",
  "Escherichia_dysenteriae"       = "#66A61E",
  "Bacillus_A_thuringiensis"      = "#E6AB02",
  "Staphylococcus_haemolyticus"   = "#A6761D",
  "Acinetobacter_oleivorans"      = "#666666",
  "Others"                        = "#D9D9D9"
)

# plot
p_species_mean_age <- ggplot(df_species_mean_age,
                         aes(x = age_group, y = mean_abund * 100, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
           width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_species, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(y = "Relative abundance at Species level (%)",
       x = "", fill = "Species") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("<50" = "<50\n(n = 20)",
                              "≥50" = "≥50\n(n = 18)"))+
  labs(x = "Age at MBC diagnosis")
p_species_mean_age
ggsave("../Output/Plots/p_species_mean_age.pdf", p_species_mean_age, width = 7, height = 4)
```

# merge ctc - species level
```{r}
# add group info
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)
# 

# ctc meta
meta_ctc <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ctc2 = case_when(
      CTC_count_cat %in% c("0", "0-5") ~ "0–5",
      CTC_count_cat %in% c(">5")  ~ ">5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctc2))

keep_samples <- rownames(meta_ctc)

physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(keep_samples, physeq)
sample_data(physeq_filtered)$ctc2 <- meta_ctc$ctc2

##
physeq_other_Species_ctc <- physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Species") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(
    Species = as.character(Species),
    Taxa_Order = Species
  )
# merge ctc- species level
df_species_mean_ctc <- physeq_other_Species_ctc %>%
  group_by(ctc2, Species) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Taxa_Order = Species)

# top20 species by global mean
top20_species <- df_species_mean_ctc %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(global_mean = mean(mean_abund)) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_mean)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(Species)

# Others

  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% top20_species, Species, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(ctc2, Species) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = sum(mean_abund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c(top20_species, "Others")))
```

```{r}
  (p_species_mean_age + p_species_mean_race) /
  (p_species_mean_ER + p_species_mean_ctc) +
  #plot_layout(guides = "collect") +     
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```
